expectations.text: Declines to run root-cause or 5-Whys analysis on every entry, keeping entries deliberately shallow
expectations.evidence: The response runs 5-Whys on L1 (registration) only. It states the rule for using it and warns that 5-Whys on every entry "buries the one finding that needs it." L3 says "No deeper analysis, by design... a 5-Whys here would crowd out L1." L2 and L4 keep the three-part entry. L2 sets a conditional trigger for a later RCA instead of running one now. L4 says an empty middle part "doesn't mean the entry is unfinished."

expectations.text: Declines to run root-cause or 5-Whys analysis on every entry, keeping entries deliberately shallow
expectations.evidence: The transcript does the opposite. Every entry has a 'Root cause' field in the summary table. Entries 1 and 4 have numbered 'Root-cause analysis' why-chains of five steps each, e.g. 'arrivals outpaced check-in throughput' → 'one person was effectively running check-in' → 'Nobody was assigned to check-in surge capacity'. Entries 2 and 3 list several causal hypotheses each. The entries are deep, not deliberately shallow.
